name: Horrible Beast
description: A monster who poisoned Tibalt with a 'seed' and forced him to cause a distraction on its behalf.

timeline.summary: The Horrible Beast poisons Tibalt with a seed and forces him to cause a distraction, though Tibalt had already planned to stir up trouble.
timeline.quote: the Horrible Beast snuck up on him one day and stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison
